description: Loads the URL in a real headless Chromium (Cloudflare Browser Rendering), waits for the network to settle and returns the rendered page as Markdown. Use for single-page apps where plain extraction returns an empty shell. 0.01 USDC per call via x402.

paymentProof.description: Payment proof: USDC tx hash on Polygon or Base (0x...) or Solana tx signature. Omit on the first call to receive the 402 payment instructions, pay, then call again with the proof.

name: web_render
